PET_FRIENDLY.label: Pet Friendly
PET_FRIENDLY.description:
While at our pet-friendly hotel, we ask that you and your four-legged friend follow our Pet Guidelines to ensure that everyone enjoys their stay in Midtown Atlanta.
●	Pets are allowed in guestrooms on any floor
●	Pets are not permitted in the fitness center, pool, or restaurant
●	All pets must be housebroken
●	Please keep your pet on a leash at all times in public spaces
●	Please clean up after your pet
●	Out of respect for other guests, we ask that your furry friend settles down by 8:30 p.m. If you are leaving the room, please leave a cell phone number at the front desk in case of an emergency
●	If a pet is disturbing hotel guests due to barking or crying, Hyatt Centric Midtown Atlanta has the right to ask that the pet be taken off the property
●	Hyatt Centric Midtown Atlanta does not assume any liability for your pet's actions while at our pet-friendly hotel
●	A $100 USD fee will apply per stay up to six nights.  Additional fees may apply for any significant cleaning or damage caused by the pet during your stay.
●	7-30 nights: An additional $100 Deep Cleaning fee will be applied (for a total of $200)
●	30+ nights: The charge will be at the hotel’s discretion.

Service Animal Pet Policy
●	Deep cleaning fees will not apply for guests with service animals
●	Service animals are allowed in all public areas

PET_FRIENDLY.label: Pet Friendly
PET_FRIENDLY.description: Guidelines for Dog Owners: 1-6 nights: $100 - 7-30 nights: $100, plus an additional deep cleaning fee of $100. For 30+ nights: Fee based on hotel’s discretion to ensure maximum comfort for all our guests, following the departure of a guest and their pet after a 7–30-night stay, there are certain steps that we must take to ensure the suite is left clean and free from possible allergens. We deep clean carpets, drapes, bedspreads and other linens. We also fumigate the suite. The cost of performing this extra cleaning is approximately $100. For this reason, we add a nonrefundable cleaning charge to the account when a guest checks in for 7–30 nights with a pet. The Hyatt Place brand limits pets to two (2) dogs per room, weighing less than 50 pounds each. All dogs must be housebroken. We reserve the right to refuse dogs that do not meet customary standards for household dogs, based on species, odor or aggressiveness. Your pet must be confined in a carrier if left unattended during the cleaning of your room; you can also plan to be present when your room is serviced. Pets are not allowed in public areas, food service areas or at the pool. We suggest guests with pets use side or back entrances. Dogs must be on leashes when in public areas.

Pench National Park
Village : Jamtara,
Post Office : Chand
Tehsil : Chaurahi
District : Chindwara – 480110
Madhya Pradesh

m0293.name: Jamtara Wilderness Camp

m0295.name: Castelbrac

m0296.description: On Japan's northernmost island, Zaborin is a heavenly hotel stay with all of the discreet elegance the country is famous for.
m0296.name: Zaborin

m0297.description: An eight-room luxury hotel on a working plantation, Glenburn Tea Estate is a serene hideaway amid hundreds of hectares of greenery.

Glenburn Tea Estate & Boutique Hotel
P.O Singritam

m0297.name: Glenburn Tea Estate

m0298.description: Traditional architecture meets mid-century design at Rosa Et Al Townhouse, a city retreat with six rooms and a creative kitchen in Porto's artistic quarter.

Rohet Garh, Village- Rohat, Dist. Pali
Pin - 306421

m0299.name: Rohet Garh

m0301.description: A whimsical addition to Bath's boutique hotel scene, No. 15 by Guesthouse, Bath has a Georgian facade that gives way to a treasure trove of witty English eccentricism inside.
m0301.name: No. 15 by Guesthouse, Bath

m0302.description: Verdant forests, azure waters and a powder-soft stretch of private sands: boutique resort Nay Palad Hideaway ticks all the right boxes for a romantic getaway.

location.addressLine1: 8419 Malinao Rd, Malinao, General Luna, Siargao Island

m0302.name: Nay Palad Hideaway

location.addressLine1: No.4, Rue Bussy Street, Lal Bahadur Shasthri Road,

m0304.name: Palais de Mahe

m0305.description: Profiting from the pine-shaded peace of Alentejo, Sublime Comporta is an upscale retreat of villas and suites, regional gastronomy and lo-fi wellness.
m0305.name: Sublime Comporta

m0306.description: Surrounded by sun-dappled Ibizan countryside, secluded retreat Ca Na Xica sits in a bucolic setting amid the island's plentiful fruit and olive trees.
m0306.name: Ca Na Xica

m0307.description: Immersed in nature, Vira Vira offers upscale, cabin-style rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the forests and mountains of Chile's Lake District.
m0307.name: AndBeyond Vira Vira

m0308.description: If Provence's most famous son, Cézanne were painting today, he'd be inspired by the masterpiece-worthy views at  Domaine de Fontenille – a classic, vineyard-surrounded château in the Luberon Natural Park.
m0308.name: Domaine de Fontenille

m0310.description: On the cusp of the Last Hope Sound in Puerto Natales, the Singular Patagonia is a symbol of Chile's industrial revolution transformed into a luxury hotel.
m0310.name: The Singular Patagonia

location.addressLine1: Calle a Sequitor s/n, Ayllú de Yaye, San Pedro de Atacama.

m0311.name: Tierra Atacama, Beckons

m0312.description: Soaring, sweeping Tierra Patagonia, Beckons in Chile segues into the local landscape, on the shores of Lake Sarmiento and in the shadows of the Torres del Paine peaks.

location.addressLine1: On the edge of Torres del Paine National Park

m0312.name: Tierra Patagonia, Beckons

m0313.description: Prepare to have your socks, sandals and sundries knocked off every which way by Refugia Chiloé Hotel & Spa, an architectural jaw-dropper on adventurous Chiloé Island.

location.addressLine1: Quilico Rural S/N, Sector San José, Castro

m0313.name: Refugia Chiloe Hotel & Spa

m0314.description: Luxury lodge Explora Torres del Paine sits on the grassy shores of Lake Pehoé, a setting suited to its thirst for adventure and full of Chilean charm.
m0314.name: Explora Torres del Paine

m0315.description: At boutique stay Explora Atacama, take advantage of guided horseback riding and hiking, then unwind in the pools or hot springs. Rooms are understated and low-tech, and meals are a locavores dream come true.
m0315.name: Explora Atacama

m0316.description: The mysterious, monolithic Moai may be what draw you to Easter Island, but Explora Rapa Nui ensures you won't want to leave.
m0316.name: Explora Rapa Nui

m0317.description: If pirates were around today, they'd have one eye on boutique hotel Artist Residence Cornwall. This bold and beautiful collection of one-of-a-kind rooms is set in a dashing Georgian pile in the heart of historic Penzance.
m0317.name: Artist Residence Cornwall

m0318.description: The Asbury Hotel is a Scandi-inspired coastal bolthole in Jersey Shore, that comes alive in the summer with a beer garden, rooftop cinema and poolside parties.
m0318.name: The Asbury Hotel

m0320.description: At first glance boutique hotel the Artist Residence Oxfordshire looks like your typical English idyll; however, on the inside, the original inglenook fireplace and flagstone floors clash happily with hip modern design.
m0320.name: Artist Residence Oxfordshire

m0321.description: Wellness retreat and luxury hotel Chablé Yucatán is one of the world's only stays with its very own cenote – and an impressive tequila collection.
m0321.name: Chablé Yucatán

m0322.description: A bit of the Med in the middle of the Caribbean Sea; the oh-so-luxurious Gyp Sea in Saint Barths brings the flamboyance of the Cote d'Azur to Flamand Bay.
m0322.name: Gyp Sea Saint Barth

m0323.description: Bringing 17th-century Dutch-colonial style into the 21st century, luxury hotel Fort Bazaar is a chic contemporary bolthole in Sri Lanka's historic coastal hotspot, Galle.
m0323.name: Fort Bazaar

m0324.description: On top of a mountain, amid paddy fields and rainforests, luxury retreat Santani Wellness Resort & Spa sits in prime position for relaxation and detoxification.
m0324.name: Santani Wellness Kandy

m0325.description: With great powder comes great responsibility, and Dunton Town House in Telluride takes on the challenge with its cosy living room and quaint, Tyrolean-style rooms.
m0325.name: Dunton Town House

m0326.description: The purveyors of sweet treats behind Reykjavik's Sandholt bakery have crafted an equally tempting dish in Sandhotel, a cosy boutique stay in the city centre.
m0326.name: Sandhotel

m0327.description: Join the beekeeper, the soap-maker and the lucky resident horses at Borgo Pignano Volterra Tuscany, which sits at the heart of an eye-poppingly scenic 750-acre organic estate in Tuscany.
m0327.name: Borgo Pignano Volterra Tuscany

m0328.description: You're unlikely to have bedded down in a Sri Lankan national park before; change that with a trip to Gal Oya Lodge, whose boutique bungalows occupy a 20-acre private forest, home to expert rangers, white-bellied sea eagles and the occasional bathing
m0328.name: Gal Oya Lodge

m0329.description: Boutique hotel Les Roches Rouges has sweeping views of the Mediterranean Sea, a carefully-curated cocktail list and two photogenic pools.

location.addressLine1: 90 Boulevard de la 36e Division du Texas

m0329.name: Les Roches Rouges

m0330.description: Fancy pretending you're Fifties film stars? Villa Marie Saint Tropez is the perfect place, in a peaceful pine forest on a pretty hillside in Ramatuelle (obliging staff will go along with the fantasy).
m0330.name: Villa Marie Saint Tropez

m0331.description: Set high on a hillside above the Guanacaste coast, Casa Chameleon, in Las Catalinas, is a cluster of villas with the romance levels set to high.
m0331.name: Casa Chameleon Las Catalinas

m0333.description: Boutique hotel Thotalagala is a colonial-style, seven-room stay, where alfresco breakfasts and old-world-style dinners are second only to tea time.
m0333.name: Thotalagala

m0337.description: Chile’s luxurious Awasi Atacama desert lodge assigns each of its adobe cabanas a multilingual (spirit) guide of its own. Learned in all things Andean, and with a four-wheel drive at their disposal, your guru will enlighten and educate.
m0337.name: Awasi Atacama

m0338.description: A former palazzo with fragrant gardens, vaulted ceilings and sun-trapping terraces, boutique hotel Don Tuto invites you to slip seamlessly into the south-Italian lifestyle.
m0338.name: Don Totu

m0339.description: For those with a taste for the finer things, luxury Devonshire hotel Lympstone Manor is a gourmet getaway, which has been lovingly cooked up by celebrated chef Michael Caines.
m0339.name: Lympstone Manor

m0340.description: Accessed by boat, all-villa hotel An Lam Retreat Ninh Van Bay sits between a secluded, southeast Asian beach and a tropical peninsula, with a lotus-like restaurant that hovers over the water.
m0340.name: An Lam Retreats Ninh Van Bay
m0340.nameHyphenated: An Lam Retreats Ninh Van Bay
m0340.mobileName: An Lam Retreats Ninh Van Bay
m0340.shortName: An Lam Retreats Ninh Van Bay

m0342.description: Boutique Valletta hotel the Saint John pairs retro-inspired design with the historic character of a 17th-century Maltese home.
m0342.name: The Saint John

m0343.description: The manor house at Leeu Estates is tastefully luxurious. But it’s the outdoors that takes the starring role, from the spa amid the vines to the pools reflecting the sunshine.
m0343.name: Leeu Estates

m0345.description: Boutique hotel 1898 The Post occupies Ghent’s former post office, a tour de force of neo-Gothic architecture built for the 1913 World’s Fair.
m0345.name: 1898 The Post

m0346.description: With its art-filled suites and pools set between the sand dunes, boutique hotel Bahia Vik José Ignacio echoes the free spirit of Uruguay’s hippest beach town.
m0346.name: Bahia Vik José Ignacio

m0347.description: Set in the fertile foothills of Italy’s evergreen island of Salina, Principe Di Salina is a dazzling-white boutique hotel in the Aeolian archipelago.
m0347.name: Principe di Salina

m0348.description: With its imposing roof and decorative timber framing, rural bolthole Manoir de Surville has bags of Norman charm.
m0348.name: Manoir de Surville

m0349.description: Former convent, Anticavilla Hotel has the holy trinity of luxury hotels: an indulgent spa, an enormous heated pool and a to-dine-for restaurant – hallelujah.
m0349.name: Anticavilla Hotel

m0350.description: A modern take on Myconian architecture, boutique hotel Branco Mykonos offers bohemian-tinged style on the edge of one of the island’s best beaches.
m0350.name: Branco Mykonos

m0351.description: Walk on the wild side at all-inclusive luxe jungle hideout Awasi Iguazú, in Argentina’s rugged Misiones province.
m0351.name: Awasi Iguazú

m0352.description: Bucolic boutique hotel, the Lygon Arms in Broadway village, has all we could ask for from a Cotswolds country getaway: period features, a spa, myriad eateries and a guest-book filled with former monarchs’ John Hancocks.
m0352.name: The Lygon Arms

m0353.description: Cobblers Cove is Barbados at its finest: pastel-shaded suites set around a tropical garden and pool terrace, overlooking a secluded strip of golden sand on the island’s coveted west coast.
m0353.name: Cobblers Cove Barbados

m0354.description: Boutique hotel Playa Vik José Ignacio teams beach-town bohemianism with swooping concrete curves, bold interiors and artworks worthy of Uruguay’s national gallery.

location.addressLine1: Calle Los Cisnes esq. Los Horneros s/n

m0354.name: Playa Vik José Ignacio

m0355.description: Lovers of lesser-trodden coastlines will fall hard for Sri Lankan boutique hotel Kumu Beach, a placid 10-room hideout a stone's throw from the golden sand.
m0355.name: Kumu Beach

m0356.description: Occupying stone farmhouses in the rolling hills of Val d’Orcia, Locanda in Tuscany offers serenity, sweeping views and traditional Tuscan dishes paired with world-class local wines.
m0356.name: Locanda in Tuscany

m0357.description: First built by the Dutch East India Company then inhabited by an order of Anglican monks, boutique hotel the Old Rectory merges Western Cape history with sleek and soothing design.
m0357.name: The Old Rectory

m0358.description: Set into a hillside in the Sacred Valley of the Incas, boutique hotel Inkaterra Hacienda Urubamba is rooted in Peruvian history and framed by regal mountains.
m0358.name: Inkaterra Hacienda Urubamba

m0359.description: Whether you’ve opted for a cosy double, or an expansive apartment-style suite, you’ll sleep soundly at luxury hideaway Zannier Le Chalet in the French ski resort of Megève, waking well-rested ready to ski, spa, sip wine and repeat.
m0359.name: Zannier Le Chalet

m0361.description: Honey, you’re home – at Why House, that is. This relaxed, friendly Sri Lankan villa set in three-acre tropical gardens is all yours to play with.
m0361.name: Why House

m0363.description: Hotel Awa is a bold visual punchline of glittering glass and stone – no surprise, then, that its accomplished owner is an ambitious architect and designer.
m0363.name: Hotel Awa

m0364.description: Perched on a small hill in well-to-do Glebe, Corinda is a stately Victorian villa set in majestic period gardens.
m0364.name: The Corinda Collection

m0365.description: Carved into an 800-year-old lava field less than an hour from Reykjavík, the Retreat at Blue Lagoon delivers a double hit of otherworldly landscape and serene Scandinavian design.
m0365.name: The Retreat at Blue Lagoon

m0368.description: Beside a working vineyard in New Zealand’s most famous wine region, The Marlborough is a boutique hotel that beckons to oenophiles and outdoorsy-types alike.
m0368.name: The Marlborough

m0369.description: If we had hooves, we’d clap them together in joyful appreciation of the Cow: a friendly pub with rooms near Derby.
m0369.name: The Cow

m0370.description: Perfectly placed between Cannes and Grasse, La Reserve by Mougins Luxury Hotel is a homestay-style haven in the South of France.
m0370.name: Mougins Luxury Hotel

m0371.description: Occupying a restored masseria, Dimora delle Balze is a masterpiece of 19th-century Sicilian style, with stone columns, a saltwater pool and homegrown produce.
m0371.name: Dimora delle Balze

m0372.description: Straddling the coastal hills just outside San Sebastián, design hotel Akelarre is a perfect storm of head-turning interiors, dining worthy of three Michelin stars and soaring views over the Bay of Biscay.
m0372.name: Akelarre

m0373.description: Smack bang in the centre of downtown Reykjavik, Kvosin Hotel is charmingly historic on the outside, but inside you’ll find swish, Scandi-style interiors and a bar that'll please the pickiest connoisseur.
m0373.name: Kvosin Hotel

m0374.description: Prepare to fall hook, line and sinker for adults-only 28 Degrees Byron Bay, a family-run guesthouse with Australian beach charm in (buckets and) spades.
m0374.name: 28 Degrees Byron Bay

m0375.description: Barefoot and boutique Jalakara hotel is a rustic rainforest retreat in India’s Andaman Islands with just seven rooms.
m0375.name: Jalakara

m0376.description: Welcome to Borgo Canonica, a revamped rural village with 42 trulli, sitting pretty in six-hectare Puglian grounds perfumed with Mediterranean maquis, lavender and fruit trees.
m0376.name: Borgo Canonica

m0377.description: At boutique Gillham Vineyard Hotel in the north part of Cyprus, you can while away your mornings in the glittering pool or holistic spa and your afternoons sampling the fruit of the vines…
m0377.name: Gillham Vineyard Hotel

m0379.description: Modern cabin-style villas, world-class links and farm-fresh fare – these are just a few of our favourite things about Kinloch Manor & Villas on New Zealand’s North Island.
m0379.name: Kinloch Manor & Villas

m0380.description: Abaton Island Resort & Spa on the north coast of Crete is white-on-white paradise, with stunning sea views and five first-class eateries.
m0380.name: Abaton Island Resort & Spa

m0381.description: Just a couple of hours west of Mexico City, La Casa Rodavento is a super-chic stay for those in the know.
m0381.name: La Casa Rodavento

m0382.description: Rodavento Valle de Bravo is a wood-and-steel architectural symphony in a 55-acre forest, home to a glittering lake and swimming pool, rolling hills and an outdoorsy activities centre.

location.addressLine1: Km 3.5 Carretera Valle de Bravo, Los Saucos

m0382.name: Rodavento Valle de Bravo

m0383.description: Mix the beauty of the past with the comfort of the present at Cressa Suites, where modern design rubs sun-kissed shoulders with Ottoman relics and Venetian stonework.
m0383.name: Cressa Suites

m0384.description: Raise a glass to the utterly lovely Mudbrick Vineyard and Restaurant on Waiheke Island: a delicious blend of romantic cottages, sea-and-vine views and some very fine wining and dining…
m0384.name: Mudbrick Vineyard and Restaurant

m0385.description: An venerable Cyprus institution, Annabelle is a grande dame who’s ruled the waves around here for decades.
m0385.name: Annabelle

m0387.description: With a private beach, seven pools and a seafood restaurant lapped by the Adriatic, waterfront hotel La Peschiera reads like a love letter to the Puglian seaside.
m0387.name: La Peschiera

m0388.description: Sugar palms and hanging orchids line the black-tiled pool of meditation-inducing Villa Mahabhirom, a village complex of traditional, teak-built Thai abodes, each raised on stilts and filled with eclectic antique art.
m0388.name: Villa Mahabhirom

m0392.description: Wave chasers, rejoice: boho boutique stay Noah Surf House sits right by the sand in Santa Cruz on Portugal’s Silver Coast.
m0392.name: Noah Surf House

m0393.description: In the officially magical Valle de Bravo, Cinco Rodavento is a boutique bolthole with a rooftop restaurant, petite pool and crowd-drawing cantina west of Mexico City.

location.addressLine1:
Calle 5 de Mayo #111,
Santa María Ahuacatlán

m0393.name: Cinco Rodavento

m0394.description: Each element of Hôtel Monte Cristo, on the Left Bank, was inspired by 19th-century literary travels, including tapestry-clad rooms and a lobby of curios.
m0394.name: Hôtel Monte Cristo Paris

m0396.description: Camellia Hills – in the heart of Sri Lanka’s tea country – may have heaps of history on its doorstep, but this hotel is a thoroughly modern affair.
m0396.name: Camellia Hills

m0397.description: Spanning a sunny stretch of Caribbean coastline, Ibagari Boutique Hotel in Honduras’ Bay Islands is a jungle-covered hideaway with a whole lot of art.
m0397.name: Ibagari Boutique Hotel

m0398.description: Tourists, in the idyllic Berkshire hills, is no ordinary motel. Yes, it’s on a road (the scenic Mohawk Trail) and retains an easy-going, feel-good charm – but it’s been given a modern-day makeover with blond-wood lodges and organic interior design.
m0398.name: Tourists

m0399.description: A remote, riverside retreat in Portugal’s Douro Valley, Quinta dos Murças is a, oenophile’s paradise: the vineyard-flanked estate makes its own wine, as well as olive oil.
m0399.name: Quinta dos Murças

m0401.description: Anchored to the Adnams brewery and distillery, The Swan, Southwold, is a lively cocktail of Georgian architecture, modern maritime style and award-winning booze.
m0401.name: The Swan Southwold

m0402.description: Inspired by the golden era of ski hotels, Caldera House brings inch-perfect interiors and top-to-tail service to the wilds of Jackson Hole, Wyoming.
m0402.name: Caldera House

m0403.description: The clue’s in the name: Water Garden Sigiriya is a liquid-lovely, watery wonderland that puts the ancient rock fortress of Sigiriya centre stage.
m0403.name: Water Garden Sigiriya

m0404.description: If Mowgli had a trust fund, he might have designed a hotel like Samode Safari Lodge: a flock of private villas set in wild Bandhavgarh National Park, where tigers roam.
m0404.name: Samode Safari Lodge

m0405.description: Explora Sacred Valley – with its guided adventures, (largely) all-inclusive feasts and lavish 17th-century spa – takes basecamp life to new heights.
m0405.name: Explora Sacred Valley

m0407.description: In India’s Uttarakhand state, the Kumaon is a Himalayan hiking lodge with walking trails, leopard spotting and a dramatic cantilevered restaurant.
m0407.name: The Kumaon

m0409.description: Marble-lined, adults-only beach retreat Lango Design & Spa Hotel – with its stylish bar and wine cellar, L-shaped pool and Turkish-inspired spa – is one of a new breed of boutique stays on Kos.
m0409.name: Lango Design Hotel & Spa

m0411.description: An intoxicating take on the traditional ski hotel, Experimental Chalet Verbier brings superlative cocktails and Seventies glamour to Swiss ski resort Verbier.
m0411.name: Experimental Chalet Verbier

m0412.description: Once owned by Sir Robert Peel, Hampton Manor used to host the cream of British society, but today it’s better known for its acclaimed restaurant and unstuffy atmosphere.
m0412.name: Hampton Manor

m0413.description: Petite Provençal hideaway La Divine Comédie is an antique-filled Avignon retreat steps from the Palais des Papes, with just five bedrooms.
m0413.name: La Divine Comédie

m0414.description: Arctic Treehouse Hotel, in Finland’s slice of the Arctic Circle, gives the den of your childhood dreams a slick Scandi makeover.
m0414.name: Arctic Treehouse Hotel

m0415.description: In Palma’s historic La Lonja quarter, Can Bordoy is a triumph of interior design, with the largest private garden in the city centre, two pools, a star restaurant and subterranean spa.
m0415.name: Can Bordoy

m0416.description: Lodge-style La Réserve Genève Hotel & Spa serves safari-inspired style on the banks of Lake Geneva, with a handful of restaurants and an all-modern spa.
m0416.name: La Réserve Genève Hotel & Spa

m0417.description: A cool climate, all the tea you can drink and refined British styling: Goatfell will have you thinking of England… until you look out at the verdant Hill Country surroundings and taste the chef’s delicious rice and curries, that is.
m0417.name: Goatfell

m0418.description: Nine Skies, a boutique bungalow on a working tea estate in Sri Lanka's Central Highlands, is a delicious tonic for body, mind and soul.
m0418.name: Nine Skies

m0419.description: Stylish surf lodge Hotel Alaia is perched amid the dunes at Punta de Lobos, a world-famous surfing destination on Chile’s rugged northern coast.
m0419.name: Hotel Alaia

m0421.description: Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa is a converted cognac distillery on the banks of the River Charente, with butter-soft interiors in an oak-beamed mansion and a fine-dining restaurant in the barrel-lined cellar.
m0421.name: Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa

m0422.description: Le Fitz Roy is a slopeside super-chalet at Europe’s highest ski resort, Val Thorens in the French Alps.
m0422.name: Le Fitz Roy

m0423.description: Deep in the Cambodian rainforest, Shinta Mani Wild is a luxe adventure basecamp that couldn’t bear scrimping on comfort or style.
m0423.name: Shinta Mani Wild

m0424.description: Disconnect from Facebook and reconnect with Mother Nature at Blackbird Byron, a three-room retreat that champions the great outdoors, from its alfresco pool to its view-toting pavilions.
m0424.name: Blackbird Byron

m0425.description: Menorca Experimental isn’t resting on its boho Balearic laurels or its Instagrammable interiors by Dorothée Meilichzon – the emphasis is still on locally sourced fare and killer cocktails.

location.addressLine1:
Batería militar de Llucalari
Camino de Llucalari

m0425.name: Menorca Experimental

m0426.description: Just outside the island’s Old Town, My Mykonos Boutique Hotel delivers Greek island minimalism and Aegean views without breaking the bank.
m0426.name: My Mykonos Boutique Hotel

m0428.description: It turns out paradise – aka Elysian Retreat – only has space for 20 lucky guests. Hop on a chopper to the aquatic Whitsundays to ensure you’re among them…
m0428.name: Elysian Retreat

m0430.description: Welcoming travellers all the way since 1680, the Lord Poulett Arms in the scenic Somerset village of Hinton Saint George is a dreamy British drinking den.
m0430.name: Lord Poulett Arms

m0431.description: Elmley Nature Reserve is a 3,300-acre off-grid escape under an hour from London, with stylish shepherd’s huts and cosy cabins looking out on a vast, wildlife-packed landscape.
m0431.name: Elmley Nature Reserve

m0432.description: Bullo River Station isn’t a hotel, it’s an experience – and a gloriously hot and dusty one at that. Discover Australia’s pioneering spirit at this hospitable working cattle station.
m0432.name: Bullo River Station

m0433.description: At L’And Vineyards in Portugal, the estate is awash with red wine, the Caudalie spa doles out grape-based treatments and plates are pitch-perfect Portuguese.

location.addressLine1:
Herdade das Valadas
Estrada Nacional 4 apartado 122

m0433.name: L'And Vineyards

m0434.description: Teetering on a cliff edge above the Adriatic, Hotel Bellevue Dubrovnik’s soothing pearly interiors are punctuated by sweeping views of sapphire seas.
m0434.name: Hotel Bellevue Dubrovnik

m0435.description: A gateway to great adventure, rural retreat Olema House is your kitschy-cool base for exploring the pristine wilderness of the Point Reyes National Seashore.
m0435.name: Olema House

m0436.description: A couple of miles out of Palomino in northern Colombia, boutique hotel One Santuario Natural is a romantic riverside retreat where Kogi shamans occasionally stay for supper.
m0436.name: One Santuario Natural

m0437.description: Luxury hotel Rosselli, at Valletta’s historic heart, was once home to 17th-century Knight of Malta Don Pietro Rosselli. A mod makeover has brought a pool, spa suites and buzzy roof terrace, but baroque-style decadence abounds, too.
m0437.name: Rosselli

m0438.description: Blessed with sigh-inducing vineyard views, Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa seduces with two irresistible pools, Michelin-star feasts and a pampering spa.
m0438.name: Royal Champagne Hotel & Spa

m0439.description: Boutique Hotel Sablon may flaunt a 16th-century façade, but, fresh from a head-to-toe renovation, this city-centre stay is thoroughly of the moment.
m0439.name: Boutique Hotel Sablon

m0440.description: Overlooking much-loved Koukounaries beach the elegant Elivi Skiathos restores a level of luxury not seen on the island since its Jackie Onassis-approved Sixties heyday.
m0440.name: Elivi Skiathos

m0441.description: The Bonnie Badger is a gastro hotspot in the East Lothian village of Gullane sporting Scandi design, heavenly pub grub and an unfussy, outdoorsy attitude.

m0442.description: A gentle stroll from the picturesque town that gives it its name, Lamego Hotel & Life’s valley-view rooms tick all the boxes for a laid-back stay near the Douro Valley.

location.addressLine1: R. de São João, 5100-010 Lamego, Portugal

m0442.name: Lamego Hotel

m0443.description: Cutting a dashing figure amid the vineyards of Champagne, hilltop Château de Sacy has characterful rooms, a gastronomic restaurant and bags of historic charm.
m0443.name: Château de Sacy

m0444.description: Steps from Porto’s top sites, Cocorico hotel is a Portuguese love letter to French culture with gorgeous local design and fabulous French food.

location.addressLine1: R. do Duque de Loulé nº 97 175

m0444.name: Cocorico

m0445.description: A wineland wonder seemingly suspended above its famous namesake river, Octant Douro brings daring modern design to a Unesco-protected valley.

location.addressLine1: Estrada Nacional 222 km 41, 4550-631 Castelo de Paiva, Portugal

m0445.name: Octant Douro

m0446.description: Natural highs abound at cosy Casa das Penhas Douradas, perched in the mountains of the Serra da Estrela Natural Park at an altitude of 1,500 metres.
m0446.name: Casa das Penhas Douradas

m0447.description: Luxury safari lodge Zannier Omaanda is under an hour’s drive from Windhoek, but its rustic looks and savannah-swathed surroundings make it feel far more wild.

location.addressLine1:
Omaanda Lodge
Farm n° 78
Rest of Ondekaremba Farm

m0447.name: Zannier Omaanda

m0448.description: Occupying a neoclassical building in the heart of Porto, The One Monumental Palace channels Thirties Paris with its dazzling art-deco design, modish brasserie and rakish cocktail lounge.
m0448.name: The One Monumental Palace

m0450.description: Namibian luxury camp Zannier Sonop, built on a spill of giant boulders amid the soaring dunes and wide-open wilds of the Namib Desert, lets you live it up in roaring vintage style.
m0450.name: Zannier Sonop

m0451.description: A humble bed and breakfast turned sleek mountain lodge, Casa de São Lourenço is a minimalist design haven nestled in the peaks of Portugal’s remote Serra da Estrela.
m0451.name: Casa de São Lourenço

m0452.description: Conversas de Alpendre in the eastern Algarve is a heavenly homestay where you’ll soon be part of the family.

location.addressLine1: Estrada de Santa Rita nº 36 Vila Nova de Cacela

m0452.name: Conversas de Alpendre

m0453.description: Infinity looks pretty good from where we’re standing at Amara in Cyprus, a majestic marble palace along the Limassol coast.
m0453.name: Amara

m0454.description: Hilltop hideaway Kahani Paradise is south of Goa, in the Indian state of Karnataka, close to hippie-favoured hideout, Gokarna.
m0454.name: Kahani Paradise

m0456.description: Cosy coaching inn the Talbot is the home of hospitality in Malton, the market town that wants to be crowned the foodie capital of Yorkshire.
m0456.name: The Talbot

m0457.description: Spread across a tree-swathed hillside, Vivood Landscape Hotel unites stark minimalism with serene mountain views – which begin at the foot of your bed.
m0457.name: Vivood Landscape Hotel

m0459.description: A far cry from the crowds in Kathmandu, Tiger Tops Karnali Lodge is on the border of Bardiya National Park, a swathe of wildlife-rich jungle in far-western Nepal.

m0461.description: Luxury lodge The Lindis blends seamlessly into the surrounding landscape of New Zealand’s Ahuriri Valley. Decadent breakfasts and dinners are included, and stress-melting spa treatments and wine tastings can be arranged.
m0461.name: The Lindis

m0462.description: Tipografia do Conto in Porto dishes out eye-candy galore, from its elegant art deco façade to its typeface-emblazoned walls and design-lover’s interiors.
m0462.name: Tipografia do Conto

m0463.description: Stare at the soaring peaks of Nepal’s most famous mountains from your own private terrace – or the edge of the serene infinity pool – at boutique hotel the Pavilions, Himalayas.
m0463.name: The Pavilions Himalayas

m0464.description: Experimental Marais is an atmospheric, design-led hotel in the Haut-Marais, home to characterful bedrooms and a restaurant where French flavours meet NYC flair.
m0464.name: Experimental Marais

m0465.description: Boutique hotel Asbury Ocean Club on the Jersey Shore has a sprawling pool, a pair of ocean-facing bars, a mod-American restaurant and a serene spa.
m0465.name: Asbury Ocean Club

m0466.description: Inspired by nature, Moss Hotel puts a fresh new spin on Hobart hospitality, sprawling across a duo of handsome heritage warehouses built by 19th-century convicts.
m0466.name: Moss Hotel

m0467.description: Cooking, culture and nature take centre stage at Santiago Hotel, a gastronomic getaway in Portugal’s agrarian Alentejo region.
m0467.name: Santiago Hotel

m0468.description: The two historic buildings that make up boutique Hotel Brosundet are some of a select handful of listed art nouveau edifices in Ålesund.
m0468.name: Hotel Brosundet

m0469.description: Turf-topped eco-lodge Storfjord Hotel is a perfectly secluded retreat nestled in the lush forest next to one of Norway’s most famous fjords.
m0469.name: Storfjord Hotel

m0470.description: Ten elegant rooms set around a serene courtyard make this intimate palazzo in the heart of Como’s old town a tucked-away treat.
m0470.name: Palazzo Albricci Peregrini

m0471.description: Built all the way back in 1506, boutique hotel Le Colonial is an aptly named private pad near Kerala's Fort Kochi.

location.addressLine1:
1/315 Church Road
Vasco da Gama Square

m0471.name: Le Colonial

m0472.description: Hosting weary travellers since 1540, boutique hotel Cirqa in the south-Peru city of Arequipa sure knows how to offer refuge.
m0472.name: Cirqa

m0473.description: Villa Saint-Ange channels the splendour of Aix-en-Provence’s honey-toned hôtel particuliers, reviving their 18th-century looks and salon-esque atmosphere.
m0473.name: Villa Saint-Ange

m0475.description: Borgo 69: it’s certainly a name you won’t forget – but it’s not the only thing that’ll stay in your mind when you visit this superlatively styled Tuscan hideaway
m0475.name: Borgo 69

m0476.description: Danish spirit has been potently distilled into luxury city-break stay Hotel Skt. Annæ, where room design uses the sophisticated palette of Copenhagen-bred artist Vilhelm Hammershøi’s works.
m0476.name: Hotel Skt. Annæ

m0477.name: Acron Villas

m0478.description: Stood amid a 35,000 hectare reserve in the Patagonian Andes, Futangue Hotel & Spa offers unfettered access to the splendour of southern Chile.

location.addressLine1:
Parque Futangue
Ruta T-85, KM 22
Lago Ranco

m0478.name: Futangue Hotel & Spa

m0479.description: Andorran mountain lodge L’Ovella Negra (‘the black sheep’) has a somewhat ironic name: guests who secure one of just four rooms here are invariably made to feel like they belong.
m0479.name: L'Ovella Negra

m0480.description: Hotel Chetzeron, a converted gondola station in Switzerland turned ski-in, ski-out boutique stay, looks out over alpine summits.
m0480.name: Hotel Chetzeron

m0481.name: Haritha Villas & Spa

m0482.description: Housed in a former 19th century inn, Life House, Nantucket now draws the island’s in-crowd with bold botanical interiors, lush gardens and top-shelf touches.
m0482.name: Life House, Nantucket

m0483.name: Paragon 700 Boutique Hotel & Spa

m0484.description: The Bird, Bath is a boutique stay with an eccentric manner and chirpy personality that’s come to rest by Bath Abbey.
m0484.name: The Bird, Bath

m0485.description: Boutique Berkshire bolthole the Pheasant Inn is the kind of country pub with rooms where we’d happily wait out the winter.
m0485.name: The Pheasant Inn

m0486.description: The Bath Arms offers the kind of reassuring, ‘get your battery back up to 100 per cent’ break that leaves you feeling truly buoyed.
m0486.name: The Bath Arms at Longleat

m0487.description: Former factory Maison Breguet draws on its retro-industrial roots and the creative spirit of Paris’ 11th arrondissement.
m0487.name: Maison Breguet

m0488.description: Farmhouse-inspired interiors, lavish linens and Aesop products – no design detail was overlooked at this elevated bed and breakfast in San Luis Obispo.
m0488.name: San Luis Creek Lodge

m0489.description: The way Mexico weaves artistry into the everyday is celebrated wholeheartedly at bohemian beachfront stay Aldea Kuká.
m0489.name: Aldea Kuká

m0491.description: Oku Kos is a boutique hotel in the Greek isles that uses a holism-with-a-wink approach to give guests a sense of wellbeing.
m0491.name: Oku Kos

m0492.description: Domaine de Primard, a country-retreating spot a short drive from Paris, was once an 18th-century château, and is now a rural retreat with clever cuisine, zhuzhed-up suites, a superlative spa and world-class gardens.
m0492.name: Domaine de Primard

m0493.name: Masseria Calderisi

m0494.name: The Inn at Newport Ranch

m0495.description: Double Red Duke is a historic, honey-hued hideout with heritage-rich interiors and a revered restaurant to tout.
m0495.name: Double Red Duke

m0496.description: Mas de Torrent is just the place for a sun-baked siesta: the pace is slow, the farmhouse is tranquil and the surroundings are sleepy.
m0496.name: Mas de Torrent

m0497.name: Kalesma Mykonos

m0498.description: The creation of Transylvania’s Bethlen Estates is an epic tale that’s been centuries in the making.
m0498.name: Bethlen Estates

m0500.description: Holistic hideaway Nomad Mykonos has a fond affiliation with the island’s unbridled nature.
m0500.name: Nomad Mykonos

m0501.description: So close to Costa Rica’s most hulking volcano that you can smell the lava, Amor Arenal takes its name from its love for the prehistoric crater in its midst.

location.addressLine1: 7 km oeste del centro de La Fortuna en la Ruta 142 camino al, Parque Nacional Volcán Arenal, Provincia de Alajuela

m0501.name: Amor Arenal

m0502.description: We prescribe a stay at Forestis, a former sanatorium turned cure-all hideaway with its head in the clouds in a particularly scenic patch of the Dolomites.

location.addressLine1:
N261-1 Estrada das Bicas
Marco da Saibreira

m0504.name: Spatia Comporta

m0508.description: Time seems to slow down at this Puglian palazzo, set in a sleepy town on Italy's heel
m0508.name: Palais Gentile

m0513.name: Casa Cook El Gouna

m0515.description: An all-encompassing beach resort of villas, residences and suites in north Mauritius, or – as the restaurants, night club and spa suggest – is it a playground?
m0515.name: Lux Grand Baie

m0519.name: Isla Palenque

m0524.name: Laqua by the Lake

m0525.description: Take it easy at Meraviglia Slow Living in Preveza, a quiet corner on the edge of the Ionian in north-western Greece.
m0525.name: Meraviglia Slow Living

m0526.description: Dexamenes Seaside Hotel, a thoughtfully converted former winery on Greece’s mountainous Peloponnese peninsula, sits directly on sandy Kourouta Beach, overlooking the gin-clear waters of the Ionian Sea.

location.addressLine1: Golkoy Region 78. Main Road 325. Street No:7

m0530.name: Bodrum Loft

m0533.name: Newhall Mains

m0534.description: Set within the ancient medina walls, Riad Fès is a grand former family residence that provides palatial living in modern-day Morocco.
m0534.name: Riad Fès

m0537.name: Vila Foz Hotel & Spa

m0538.description: The Nest cocoons you in pine, oak and other natural materials – a holistic outpost in the Serras de Aire e Candeeiros Natural Park.

location.addressLine1: 500 meters south of Villas Caribe, Punta Cocles

m0541.name: Hotel Aguas Claras

m0546.name: Aristide Hotel

m0547.description: Spot wallabies, kangaroos and koalas from your suite at Sequoia Lodge: each of the 14 rooms has a balcony, sunken lounge and freestanding bath tub with views out to the Adelaide Hills.

m0550.description: Leave a lighter safari footprint at Cherero Camp – one of Kantabile Afrika’s two eco-friendly Serengeti dwellings.
m0550.name: Cherero Camp

m0552.description: Between the Uruguayan countryside and the Atlantic is Luz Culinary Wine Lodge: a nature-first hotel with 35 acres of private land and just six rooms.

m0553.name: Aurari Camp

m0554.name: The Chedi Andermatt

m0555.description: A boutique chalet hotel in the Alpine north of Slovenia, where the fine dining, spa and homely welcome are as restorative as the views.
m0555.name: Vila Planinka

m0556.description: If you’re fond of sand dunes and salty air, you’ll love Three Mile Beach in Cornwall, a coastal collection of breezy beach houses.

m0557.name: The Moorings

location.addressLine1: Località San Vito, traversa Antica Canonica

m0562.name: Casa Olea Hotel

m0564.name: Les Hautes Mers

m0565.name: La Mourra Hôtel Village

m0566.description: This boutique mountain hotel with three slopeside chalets combines a serene village setting with superb access to the Evasion Mont-Blanc ski area.
m0566.name: Armancette

m0567.description: Antique-dotted, one-of-a-kind suites are slotted into the verdant landscape at architect Geoffrey Bawa’s country estate – a luxury retreat with a garden open for tours.
m0567.name: Lunuganga Estate

m0571.description: Who needs madeleines when you have charmant Provençal hideaway Le Moulin? This 18th-century mill (gently updated by noted architecture firm Jaune) teases out nostalgia for a pastoral past whether you lived it or not.
m0571.name: Le Moulin

m0572.description: This family-run luxe mountain stay brings together sexily rustic suites and rooms with a sophisticated restaurant in one of Andorra’s quieter outposts.
m0572.name: Les Pardines 1819

m0573.description: Find inner peace (and everything else) at Casa Hormiga, a homey hideaway a block away from the banks of lake Bacalar

location.addressLine1: Av. 3, C. 32 esquina, Mario Villanueva Madrid

m0573.name: Casa Hormiga

m0574.name: Capelongue

m0576.name: Octant Furnas

m0577.name: Palácio da Lousã Boutique Hotel

m0578.description: The Octant Ponta Delgada is a coast-hugging base from which to explore São Miguel, an ocean-surrounded island where the rest of the world feels very far away.

location.addressLine1: Av. Dr. João Bosco Mota Amaral, 4

m0578.name: Octant Ponta Delgada

m0579.description: On a stretch of oceanfront one hundred metres wide, an old stone mansion has been transformed into a contemporary stay of sugar cube-sleek suites and villas.
m0579.name: White Exclusive Suites & Villas

m0580.description: Sleekly dressed studios and villas are surrounded by eye-catching gardens and a choice of pools above a roller-lapped sandy beach favoured by surfers.

location.addressLine1: Estrada Regional nº1, 1º Morro de Baixo

m0580.name: Santa Barbara Eco Resort

m0581.description: Senhora da Rosa stands is a converted farmhouse that bears the fruits of a peaceful, private and idyllic ilha verde stay.
m0581.name: Senhora da Rosa

m0582.description: In a polished palacio in Seville’s old quarter, Gravina 51 combines period interiors and elegant communal spaces to create a B&B brimming with Andalusian charm.
m0582.name: Gravina 51

m0583.description: Much like its namesake, the Blonde Hedgehog is a rare and unique find on bijou Channel Island Alderney.
m0583.name: The Blonde Hedgehog

m0585.name: Palma Riad

m0588.description: A Casa Reale, a luxuriously lived-in bed and breakfast in Corsican port town Bastia, has stayed on the bright side of history for more than 300 years.

m0593.name: Silky Oaks Lodge, Beckons

m0594.description: A private residence dating from the 17th century, this boutique coastal stay is a warren of destination-inspired interiors crowned by a rooftop bar.

location.addressLine1: Via Garibaldi 29, ang, Via G. Presta

m0594.name: Palazzo Presta

m0596.description: At Casa Cook in the eastern Aegean isle of Samos, enjoy epicurean experiences at the Beach House and days on cabanas suspended over a swimming pool.
m0596.name: Casa Cook Samos

m0597.description: In a feat greater than scaling Mount Fitz Roy (this region’s soaring poster boy), cosseting wilderness lodge Explora El Chaltén succeeds in making you feel at home in territory where humans are something of an afterthought.

location.addressLine1:
Ruta Provincial No. 41 km 17
Estancia Los Huemules

m0597.name: Explora El Chaltén

m0598.description: Château Capitoul is a luxury hotel and hamlet of elegant villas in the Languedoc’s Massif de la Clape, with its mountains, lagoons, garrigue and forest. It’s a potent blend of the region’s riches.
m0598.name: Château Capitoul

m0600.description: Hear us out on wellness retreat Yeotown Madeira, the first of its kind on the Portuguese isle. Its owners helped guests hit refresh in Devon for years and now run their programme from an antique farmhouse on an ocean-side estate.

location.addressLine1:
Caminho do Verde 60
Arco da Calheta

m0600.name: Yeotown Madeira

m0601.description: Overlooked by the chapel bell tower next door, I Tre Bacili’s six vaulted guestrooms cluster around lemon-scented courtyards, elevated stone terraces and an enticing pool.
m0601.name: I Tre Bacili

m0602.description: Finessed interiors and a home-from-home set-up, bolstered by digital concierge service, make apartment stay Butterfly Verona a superlative city bolthole.
m0602.name: Butterfly Verona

m0603.description: Built as a family home in 1905 (although now over-18s only, due to dainty vintage finds), and operating as a guesthouse since the 1940s, Maleny Lodge has a strong legacy of making those who cross its white-picket fence and restful porchfront feel welcome.
m0603.name: Maleny Lodge

m0605.description: The two Costa Rican mansions comprising Ocio Villas have private pools, a helipad and many decks from which to admire your kingdom, but also offer the kind of rampant jungle-to-coast-scenery you’d need several viewmaster reels to contain.
m0605.name: Ocio Villas by Casa Chameleon

m0607.description: A discreet townhouse in the cobbled alleys of Île de Ré’s pretty Saint-Martin port, Villa Clarisse is as quiet and calming as the island’s remote pine forests and beaches.
m0607.name: Villa Clarisse

m0608.description: On the quayside of Île de Ré’s idyllic Saint-Martin port, Hotel de Toiras is a breezy base for cycling trips to this undiscovered isle’s remote villages and beaches.
m0608.name: Hôtel de Toiras

m0609.description: Petite but perfectly formed Marina Piccola 73 is a harbourside haven in Sorrento, with a rooftop terrace for Vesuvius views and hearty homemade breakfasts.
m0609.name: Marina Piccola 73

m0610.description: With enough glossy woodwork and carpentry to make Geppetto proud, Taller de Juan is a stylish studio in the southern-Mexico state of Chiapas.
m0610.name: Taller de Juan Casa-Hotel

m0612.description: Villa Nai 3.3 is located near the village of Žman on the slender island of Dugi Otok, Croatia.
m0612.name: Villa Nai 3.3

m0613.description: Overlooking a palm-strewn six-acre plantation with a lake, Villa Bokéh is an art-filled colonial-style mansion that boasts uninterrupted views of the soaring Volcán de Agua.

location.addressLine1: Lote 3, Camino a Finca San Nicolás

m0613.name: Villa Bokéh

m0616.description: A multi-level boutique hotel set on a hillside, Casa Palopó overlooks Lake Atitlán from every terrace and has colourful, rustic-luxe suites plus an exclusive villa.

location.addressLine1: Carretera a San Antonio Palopó, km 6.8

m0616.name: Casa Palopó

m0617.description: Wildhive Callow Hall, set amid wildness at the tippy-toe of the Peak District National Park, is a joy with its best of British fare, treehouses and cosy nooks.
m0617.name: Wildhive Callow Hall

m0618.description: Since County Tipperary’s immensely grand Palladian Cashel Palace was built in 1728 by big-deal-back-then architect Edward Lovett Pearce, it’s lived many lives.
m0618.name: The Cashel Palace

m0619.description: Azade Chania is a Venetian villa in the heart of the old harbour, once the home of Charles Henri Ford and an Ottoman pasha.
m0619.name: Azade Chania

m0620.description: Meneghetti Wine Hotel & Winery is an isolated idyll deep in the Istrian countryside on an estate of lush vineyards and olive groves.
m0620.name: Meneghetti Wine Hotel & Winery

m0621.description: Charming by name, charming by nature; family-owned Colegio Charm house woos hearts as smoothly as a doting lover with handwritten notes, fresh-out-the-oven cakes and oh-so-dreamy interiors.
m0621.name: Colegio Charm House

m0622.description: With the Three Valleys ski area on its doorstep, this designer mountain lodge and spa is a welcome addition to the Tarentaise village of Saint-Martin-de-Belleville.
m0622.name: M Lodge

m0623.description: Down a leafy Suffolk lane, Retreat East is set on a 16th-century dairy farm, with 21 beautifully kitted-out barns and a local-produce-obsessed chef
m0623.name: Retreat East

m0624.description: Cast away on a Lilliputian isle in the Lesser Antilles, amid flamboyant tropical gardens, Golden Rock Resort practically defines the term ‘remote’.
m0624.name: Golden Rock Dive & Nature Resort

m0627.description: Cap St Georges Hotel & Resort sits amid olive and cypress groves in 11 acres of manicured gardens overlooking the Med on Cyprus’s divine west coast.
m0627.name: Cap St Georges Hotel & Resort

m0628.description: Formerly a roadside motel, Berkshires Untold has transformed itself into a dapper, convivial retreat deep in the New England mountains.
m0628.name: Berkshires Untold

m0629.description: At century-old Catskills resort Callicoon Hills, there’s a sense of nostalgia as cosy as the cuddle of a vintage blanket as you toast a s’more over a fire pit.
m0629.name: Callicoon Hills

m0631.description: If the Cotswolds embody the quintessential English idyll, then Temple Guiting Manor & Barns distils the region’s ample charms further into 15 acres of rustic-retreat perfection.
m0631.name: Temple Guiting Manor & Barns

m0633.description: Wellness-focused bed and breakfast Can Mascort Eco Hotel will lift your spirits before you’ve set foot inside, with its cheery goldenrod façade standing out like a beacon in Catalan Palafrugell’s historic centre, just inland of the Costa Brava.
m0633.name: Can Mascort Eco Hotel

m0634.description: Guests truly dig in deep at Portugal’s Craveiral Farmhouse – perhaps literally if they help out with the resident donkeys, horses and pygmy goats – a labour of love by a former lawyer who fell madly in love with an Alentejo carnation farm.
m0634.name: Craveiral Farmhouse

m0635.description: A grande dame hotel with a country club feel close to London, The Grove now has revamped rooms, restaurants and appeal to little Smiths to add to its charms.
m0635.name: The Grove

m0638.description: Nature is placed front and center at Cali Mykonos; a Cycladic cliffhanger that fuses Green tradition with oh-so-contemporary comforts.
m0638.name: Cali Mykonos

m0640.description: Amyth of Mykonos’s Greek island style – we covet you so. However, we must admit that like swinging in a macramé hammock, gorging on souvlaki and watching Aegean sunsets, it can’t be recreated back home.
m0640.name: Amyth of Mykonos

m0641.description: Set in the glorious 19th-century Renaissance Revival building that once housed Bergen’s former stock exchange (plus two buildings for the DNB banking group), by the city’s famous fish market, Bergen Børs Hotel is a high-net-worth individual.
m0641.name: Bergen Børs Hotel

m0643.description: A traditional Spanish-style hacienda deep in the Napa Valley, Rancho Caymus Inn promises spacious ranch-style rooms, poolside fire pits and a curated wine list sourced from dozens of local wineries.
m0643.name: Rancho Caymus Inn

m0644.description: Casa Beatnik Country House is a hot-pink palazzo surrounded by vineyards in Galicia’s sun-dappled terroir where a hodge-podge of patterns and textures take centre stage.
m0644.name: Casa Beatnik Country House

m0647.description: Serendipity is an abiding guest at Palacio de Luces, which offers suites that are indeed cool, dining for the ages, sierras to eye up and enticing little peeks into a noble family's past.
m0647.name: Palacio de Luces

m0648.description: The spa is the star at Adler Sicilia, a coastal estate of luxe suites with farm-to-table cuisine and a sandy beach to boot.
m0648.name: Adler Sicilia

m0649.description: Get cloistered away at Coqui Coqui Casa de los Santos, a blessed boutique stay with just one suite amid the golden streets of Mexico’s ‘Yellow City’, Izamal.

location.addressLine1:
Calle 31 N. 277 (Entre 26 y 28)
Colonia Centro
Izamal

m0649.name: Coqui Coqui Casa de los Santos
m0649.nameHyphenated: Coqui Coqui Casa de los Santos
m0649.mobileName: Coqui Coqui Casa de los Santos
m0649.shortName: Coqui Coqui Casa de los Santos

m0650.description: Brookdale Estate epitomises dreaming big – the enormity of the Drakenstein Mountains and scale of the Paarl Valley make even this grand Cape Dutch manor seem diminutive.

location.addressLine1:
Hawequa Bos Pad
Klein Drakenstein Road

m0650.name: Brookdale Estate

m0651.description: Sicilian showstopper Lùme is a classic Italian love story; halls of Italian stone, an Ayurvedic spa and a heart-breaking rooftop terrace? That’s amore!
m0651.name: Lùme

m0652.description: Cora Apartments are a series of eclectic residences spread across four buildings in Leipzig’s leafy Waldstraßenviertel neighbourhood, known for its well-preserved collection of distinctively Deutsche 19th-century Gründerzeit buildings.
m0652.name: Cora Apartments

m0654.description: The owners of Pa.te.os – set remotely inland in the beach-y Alentejo region – believe that it’s what’s on the outside that counts. But, in no superficial way: forest, vineyard, herb garden or human: all are well-tended to here.
m0654.name: Pa.te.os

m0657.description: Stately Castro Hotel Syros is a lovingly refurbished mansion hotel in the port city of Hermoupolis, on the Greek island of Syros.
m0657.name: Castro Hotel Syros

m0658.description: Just south of Dubrovnik in Cavtat, Hotel Supetar is a vintage villa that was built on the site of an ancient settlement.
m0658.name: Hotel Supetar

m0660.description: Castle Elvira: the manor, the myth, the legend… Topped with crenellated turrets and surrounded by enchanted forest (and groves), this is a storybook 20th-century Puglian stay.
m0660.name: Castle Elvira

m0662.description: If you’re in a slump and need to invoke the muse, she won’t turn up for anything less than Villa Lena, a bright spark of an artists’ retreat amid glorious Tuscan countryside.
m0662.name: Villa Lena

m0664.description: Three distinct shades of blue are all you’ll see from your private pool at Ios Grand Pool Suites, as you take lazily long lunches and calming cocktails served right to your terrace.
m0664.name: Ios Grand Pool Suites

m0666.description: The Sanubari looks like the blueprint for a luxurious beach resort, but its setting on the lesser-known Indonesian isle of Sumba gives it an authentic edge.

location.addressLine1:
Dasang Beach
Harona Kala
Laboya Barat

m0666.name: The Sanubari

m0667.description: A super-sustainable forest eco-lodge near Marinilla, Cannúa’s rooms and cabanas overlook the rolling hills and rustic farmsteads of the San Nicolás Valley from their lofty mountainside vantage point.
m0667.name: Cannúa

m0668.description: The Hideout White Bay is a beguiling, seven-villa hideaway on Jost Van Dyke island’s scenic same-name beach, in the British Virgin Islands.
m0668.name: The Hideout White Bay

m0669.description: The Royal Sands Koh Rong resort is an all-out luxury beach retreat on a paradise Cambodian isle.
m0669.name: The Royal Sands Koh Rong

m0670.description: Outdoors adventures change with the season at the Lake House on Canandaigua in the Finger Lakes, whereas artisan-crafted interiors, sybaritic extras and laid-back bonhomie are its calendar-proof constants.
m0670.name: The Lake House on Canandaigua

m0671.description: Thailand retreat TreeHouse Villas is a compact, luxury beach resort made up of individual treehouse-style dwellings, all with views of Phang Nga Bay.
m0671.name: TreeHouse Villas

m0673.description: Wine flows as freely at Hotel Santa María Briones as the nearby River Ebro, a masterfully restored manor house made for modern oenophiles in the foothills of the Sierra de Cantabria.
m0673.name: Santa Maria Briones

m0674.description: Is it possible to ever tire of looking out over the cerulean sea-meets-sky vistas at the Eliamos Villas Hotel & Spa? We doubt it.
m0674.name: Eliamos Villas Hotel & Spa

m0675.description: Home to flamboyant flamenco and the ‘more is Moorish’ Alhambra, Granada wears its heart on a heavily embellished sleeve. And Seda Club hotel has translated these glamorous traits into a modern hideaway.

location.addressLine1:
Plaza de la Trinidad
Esquina Buensuceso 2

m0675.name: Seda Club Hotel

m0676.description: In Triana House Boutique Hotel designer Amaro Sánchez de Moya grabs you round the waist and twirls you through Andalusia.
m0676.name: Triana House Boutique Hotel

m0677.description: All-natural adventures await at Origins Lodge, a remote cluster of eco-conscious hideaways with hot-tubs, an organic restaurant, and Tico-inspired spa above the rainforest canopy.

location.addressLine1:
200 South from Pueblo Nuevo School
Canalete

m0677.name: Origins Lodge

m0678.description: Old meets new at Casa a Corte, a contemporary remix of Puglian Baroque stylings in the historical heart of Nardò.
m0678.name: Casa a Corte

m0679.description: This Earth-kind stay beside Lake Bohinj has the Triglav national park for a backdrop and mountain tales to tell through its decor, cuisine and impressive spa.
m0679.name: Hotel Bohinj

m0680.description: There’s no hideaway quite like Celestial Hotel Kefalonia along the island’s south coast, still wild enough for there to be untouched forest all around, and glimpses of Mount Ainos from its pool-dotted tiers that cascade down a hillside.
m0680.name: Celestial All Suites Kefalonia

m0681.description: Ladies and gents, step right up for the night of your life at the Editory Boulevard Aliados. Ride giant duckies in the pool, gasp and blush at saucy and surreal artworks, and catch the whole show in the ‘big top’ bar.
m0681.name: The Editory Boulevard Aliados

m0683.description: At the Chedi El Gouna, lifting your sunglasses to squint lazily over the shimmering Red Sea is the extent of the exertion involved.
m0683.name: The Chedi El Gouna

m0684.description: South of Tangier on Morocco’s west coast, La Fiermontina Ocean is a beachfront retreat just north of Larache – a holiday hotspot for Moroccans come summer.
m0684.name: La Fiermontina Ocean

m0685.description: The only way is up at Three House Hotel, an apartment-style home-from-home, to reach Funchal’s funkiest fusion-dining rooftop (with infinity pool).
m0685.name: Three House Hotel

m0686.description: From petite family farmhouse to a après pleasure pad, LeCrans takes chalet glamour to mountainous new heights.
m0686.name: LeCrans

m0687.description: A red-brick Broadway Street stalwart, Elevation Lofts leans into Asheville’s vibrant art scene with decor that incorporates exposed beams and brickwork and contemporary pieces from the Momentum Gallery downstairs.
m0687.name: Elevation Lofts Hotel

m0689.description: Prince Fabrizio Ruspoli di Poggio Suasa has found the most happiness in a leafy enclave of the High Atlas, where he’s designed, built and landscaped timeless botanical paradise Olinto Atlas Mountain Retreat.
m0689.name: Olinto Atlas Mountain Retreat

m0690.description: The Shoals Suites & Slips, a self-proclaimed ‘boatel’ is ready to shine the light on North Fork with Scandi-style suites that nod to Southold’s nautical past.
m0690.name: The Shoals Suites & Slips

m0691.description: Gran Hotel Mas d'en Bruno, in the wine-making Priorat region, is a fine 21st-century vintage steeped in five centuries of history.
m0691.name: Gran Hotel Mas d'en Bruno

m0693.description: There’s a timeless appeal to downtime at rural estate and wellness resort Minthis – set among olive groves, orchards, and seemingly untouched hillsides.
m0693.name: Minthis

m0694.description: With a cosy pub, fish and chip shop and classic country cottages, the Collective at Woolsery is a hit parade of England’s green and pleasant lands.

location.addressLine1:
Post Office Cottage
Chapel Street
Woolsery

m0694.name: The Collective at Woolsery

m0695.description: No place for nomads, Caravan Agafay by Our Habitas is a lively tented stay, where high-octane desert thrills and a convivial pool scene set the sociable tone.
m0695.name: Caravan Agafay by Our Habitas

m0696.description: Choo choo! Trainspotters rejoice, we’ve got just the ticket in the form of Canfranc Estación, A Royal Hideaway Hotel.
m0696.name: Canfranc Estación

m0697.description: Timbered homestead the Christopher is your bed-and-breakfast-style retreat that’s an idyll for lounging – in your spacious suite or cosied up on the porch.
m0697.name: The Christopher

m0698.description: Real estate on Martha’s Vineyard may be almost 100 per cent more expensive than anywhere else in the USA, but luckily you can borrow the Sydney.
m0698.name: The Sydney

m0699.description: A Sicilian-inspired scene from any art lover’s wildest dreams, Asmundo di Gisira invites modern aesthetes to sleepover in a living, breathing contemporary art gallery in central Catania.
m0699.name: Asmundo di Gisira

m0700.description: Sandwiched between belts of green rice-paddies, Toyama-set ryokan Rakudo-An gives tradition a craft-inspired makeover with its curated collection of local mingei (folk art), antiques and specially commissioned contemporary artworks.
m0700.name: Rakudo-An

m0701.description: In the shadow of some academic alps (AKA the Collegiate Peaks), Surf Hotel & Chateau is a hotel of two halves, with a castle in the courtyard.
m0701.name: Surf Hotel & Chateau

m0702.description: Nourishing and nurturing farmhouse hideaway Yeotown Devon has holistic and healthy methods of encouraging you through its dynamic but doable five-day wellness retreat.
m0702.name: Yeotown Devon

m0703.description: Built by a Brit émigré turned politician, Wallingford Homestead rewards those who’ve travelled far with warm welcomes, legendary tasting menus and a cosseting retreat for those who wander.
m0703.name: Wallingford Homestead

m0704.description: Torel Saboaria is a squeaky-clean stay in central Porto, with scent-themed rooms to choose from, split-level suites and a street-level café.
m0704.name: Torel Saboaria

m0705.description: Nestled between an Atlantic Ocean inlet and swathes of tropical mangrove forest, the Ka Bru Beach Boutique Hotel stands like a manicured mirage among the scenic wilds of Brazil’s Maraú Peninsula.
m0705.name: Ka Bru Beach Boutique Hotel

m0706.description: You’ll feel like a kid in a candy store at Ecuadorian farm estate and boutique hideaway Hacienda La Danesa, run by generations of the Olsen-Peet family since 1870.
m0706.name: Hacienda La Danesa

m0707.description: Wine and dine to your heart’s content at the Estate Yountville, a working Napa Valley vineyard home to Hotel Villagio and Vintage House.
m0707.name: The Estate Yountville

m0708.description: Base camps in Nepal’s remote regions can often be, well, basic, but eco-friendly Shinta Mani Mustang (part of the Bensley Collection) elevates mountain hospitality even at this high an altitude.
m0708.name: Shinta Mani Mustang

m0709.description: The creative family behind Toile Blanche hotel have put their art and soul into this all-suite Provençal farmhouse with private pools and terraces.
m0709.name: Toile Blanche

m0710.description: Sheep? Us? Surely not. But, we confess that one glimpse of the cosmopolitan shepherd’s huts set scenically across Aller Dorset’s idyllic farm, has us happily flocking to the countryside.

location.addressLine1:
Aller Farm
Aller Lane
Lower Ansty

m0710.name: Aller Dorset

m0711.description: Revitalised Victorian hotel No 42 by Guesthouse, Margate has been a front-row witness to the south-east coast’s cultural sea change; and now it’s time for its own tide to turn, as the Guesthouse group ushers in a new era of beachfront hospitality.
m0711.name: No. 42 by Guesthouse, Margate

m0712.description: Set inches from the ocean, the understated, six-key Casa Muuch is in prime beach-lazing position. Bohemian but not overtly fringed and feathered, with a private-home feel, this is a pocket-sized paradise all of your own.
m0712.name: Casa Muuch

m0713.description: Once you know family-run Kaner Retreat is named after the oleander (AKA the desert rose) the rest clicks into place.
m0713.name: Kaner Retreat

m0714.description: Petite boutique hotel Ka Bru 1100 is on the Maraú peninsula in the Brazilian state of Bahia.

location.addressLine1:
Area do Cassange
Barra Grande
Bahia

m0714.name: Ka Bru 1100 Boutique Hotel

m0716.description: A labour of love for two Apulian siblings, Il Giardino Grande is a made-over masseria deep in the handsome hinterlands of Salento.
m0716.name: Il Giardino Grande

m0717.description: A beautifully converted Fifties Basque beach house, Villa Magalean Hotel and Spa combines top-notch service, refined interiors and a near-the-Old-Town setting.
m0717.name: Villa Magalean Hotel & Spa

m0718.description: Kennebunkport Captains Collection parcels period rooms and suites into four historic houses with bed and breakfast, elegant lounges and tranquil grounds.
m0718.name: Kennebunkport Captains Collection

m0719.description: Vaquera House is cosiness incarnate, with just 10 rooms, a roaring fireplace, and the sort of organic, furry throws and lots-of-wood decor that’s best enjoyed in a curled-up position.
m0719.name: Vaquera House

m0722.description: An excellent basecamp for days at Walt Disney World, Ette Hotel is also its antidote, with destination dining, exemplary service and high-spec rooms and suites.
m0722.name: Ette Hotel

m0723.description: Zori Timeless is a compact, luxury hideaway in Palmižana on the island of Sveti Klement, Croatia.
m0723.name: Zori Timeless Hotel

m0724.description: Vietnam’s Avana Retreat is an otherworldly stay in the greener – and maybe more fantastical – than the Emerald City, rural region of Mai Chau.
m0724.name: Avana Retreat

m0725.description: Galicia’s folkloric cradle is what fairytales are made of. Just ask those at Pepe Vieira Hotel and Restaurant, who know that good food isn’t just about destination dining, but the whole journey.
m0725.name: Hotel Pepe Vieira

m0726.description: Wandering by a river amid clusters of plane trees; listening to the ‘shush’ of waves on a deserted crescent beach: just some of Onar Andros’ tranquil trappings.
m0726.name: Onar Andros

m0728.description: Cradled in the mountainous embrace of the Indian Himalayas, Dolkhar is a seven-villa stay with a plant-based restaurant and Tibetan-style spa within hiking distance of Ladakh’s mountain trails.
m0728.name: Dolkhar

m0729.description: La Dehesa de Don Pedro is a boutique hotel set in a converted 19th-century farmhouse near the historic town of Monesterio in southwestern Spain.

location.addressLine1: Carretera BA-067 km: 33,5 (Ctra. de Pallares a Santa María)

m0729.name: La Dehesa de Don Pedro

m0730.description: It may be called Boys Hall, but this 17th-century manor house has reached peak maturity with its sophisticated restaurant, grown-up bedrooms, oak-panelled pub and wild country garden.
m0730.name: Boys Hall

m0731.description: Casa do Conto is more resilient than most; its original form burnt down; but a lot of love later, this modernist city escape is blazing design trails instead.
m0731.name: Casa do Conto

m0732.description: Palazzo Maresgallo is a grand, art gallery-style stay in the heart of Lecce with a rooftop terrace, subterranean spa, and two plunge pools.
m0732.name: Palazzo Maresgallo

m0733.description: Palazzo Belvedere, a very grand hotel packed with iconic Italian furnishings, set next to Montecatini Terme’s complex of natural hot springs, also overflows with holistic healthfulness.
m0733.name: Palazzo Belvedere

m0736.description: Commanding sweeping views of the river estuary, port and sea, family-focused Fowey Hall sits along the shimmering south coast of Cornwall.
m0736.name: Fowey Hall

m0737.description: You’d think staking a claim on the only sandy beach on bohemian Greek isle Hydra would give you fame enough, but not for Mandraki Beach Resort. No – in the 19th century it was an esteemed naval base too.
m0737.name: Mandraki Beach Resort

m0739.description: Martha’s Vineyard bed and breakfast the Richard sits close to the coast, but its design veers off course from nautical trappings to a sleek monochrome look.
m0739.name: The Richard

m0740.description: Tented tranquility awaits adventure travelers at Las Qolqas, an eco-lodge in Peru’s Sacred Valley with a greenhouse restaurant, riverside spa, and geodesic wellness dome.

location.addressLine1:
Las Qolqas Eco-resort Km 2 Carretera a Willoq
Valle del Rio Patacancha

m0740.name: Las Qolqas

m0741.description: Martha’s Vineyard bed and breakfast the Edgartown Inn is a historic, former whaling captain’s home well-placed for bike rides, lighthouse looks and ice-cream stops.
m0741.name: The Edgartown Inn

m0742.description: The architectural tide is turning in New Zealand’s southerly city at Ebb Dunedin, an eco-friendly stay with a café, garden atrium, and retractable roof.
m0742.name: Ebb Dunedin

m0743.description: It’s been a while since James I and his troops conquered Palma, but their Moorish legacy remains hidden in the nooks of Puro Grand Hotel.

location.addressLine1: Carrer del Forn de la Glòria 5

m0743.name: Puro Grand Hotel

m0744.description: Family values abound at Les Regalia, a highbrow heritage hotel on Corsica’s southern coast.
m0744.name: Les Regalia

m0745.description: In its 800-year history, the Old Bell Hotel has undergone many a makeover, but don’t be fooled by its shyly wisteria-clad façade; ‘olde worlde’ this is not.
m0745.name: The Old Bell Hotel

m0746.description: Hotel Peralada sits in rolling countryside on a celebrated Alt Empordà wine estate and also boasts a golf course, a restaurant inside a mediaeval castle, and a spa.
m0746.name: Hotel Peralada Wine Spa & Golf

m0747.description: The converted Bairro do Silva neighbourhood is now home to Village by Boa, a set of Japandi-styled self-catering apartments and studios in Bolhão’s buzzing market district.
m0747.name: Village by Boa

m0748.description: Sound food, sound surrounds and a very sound sleep. You’ll find it all at Sound View Greenport; a stilted stay across a quarter-mile private beach on Long Island’s North Fork.
m0748.name: Sound View Greenport

m0749.description: In Mexico City’s coolest corner, Colima 71 - Casa de Arte Hotel is the perfect Roma Norte retreat, close to many of the capital’s famously good restaurants.
m0749.name: Colima 71 - Casa de Arte Hotel

m0750.description: Adults-only resort, Omeon Mykonos, is a place of quiet meaningful gestures, peacefully set to the north of the Greek party isle.
m0750.name: Omeon Mykonos

m0751.description: Precise Tale Poggio Alla Sala – inspired by the Silk Road that travelled through the region centuries ago – is a home where east and west merrily meet.
m0751.name: Precise Tale Poggio Alla Sala

m0752.description: High in the hills of rural Naxos, Ayiopetra is a five suite sanctuary with farm-to-table dining overlooking the ancient Temple of Demeter.
m0752.name: Ayiopetra

m0754.description: Finessed boathouses and cottages beside a river lagoon and only a short drive from Hermanus make eco retreat Coot Club an idyllic group-friendly choice.
m0754.name: Coot Club

m0755.description: Taking up residence in a 19th-century notary’s family home, the Notary is an all-suite, antique-filled manor with enchanting gardens, a natural swimming pool, and canal access.
m0755.name: The Notary

m0756.description: The Darling, a boutique stay with two self-contained pieds-à-terre in Copenhagen old town’s shopping district – will inspire many more declarations of affection.
